methodologyNotes: Covers freestanding outdoor fire pits sold at a published US price, spanning wood-burning models (including smokeless secondary-combustion designs) and gas models (propane or natural gas). Excludes built-in masonry pits, drop-in gas fire-table inserts, tabletop ethanol/gel burners under 12 in diameter, and DIY ring kits. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. fuelType is an enum: wood, wood-pellet, propane, natural-gas, or gel. material is the primary fire-bowl construction as stated by the maker (e.g. 304-stainless-steel, corten-steel, carbon-steel, cast-aluminum, enameled-steel). diameterInches is the widest outer footprint dimension in inches; for square or rectangular units it is the largest side. heightInches is overall height in inches without any optional stand unless the stand is integral. weightPounds is empty (unfueled) unit weight in pounds. heatOutputBtu is the maximum manufacturer-rated heat output in BTU per hour; null if not published, which is common for wood-burning pits. smokeless is true only for units with an engineered secondary-combustion (double-wall airflow or forced-air) system. cookingCompatible is true if the manufacturer sells a fitted grill grate or cooking accessory for the unit. ashPanRemovable is true if a removable ash pan or lift-out ash catch is included. warrantyYears is the manufacturer's stated warranty length in years; a lifetime warranty is recorded as null and noted in provenance. madeInUsa is true only if the maker states the unit is manufactured in the USA.
